config.label: Optional for initialize, ping, notifications/initialized and tools/list
config.description: Optional for initialize, ping, notifications/initialized and tools/list. Required for tools/call: Bearer <token>. Clients that support MCP OAuth sign in through the browser; discovery is at https://www.cookiefreeanalytics.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource. Paid plans may instead send a cfa_live_… API token from Account.
